// Three deliberately messy supplier documents.
// Real inputs arrive from Gmail attachments, a Drive folder or a webhook —
// this node is swapped for that trigger at deployment. Kept inline so the
// workflow runs end-to-end with no credentials beyond the model.

const samples = [
  {
    source: 'email:accounts@northgate-supplies.co.uk',
    invoiceText: `NORTHGATE SUPPLIES LTD
17 Bramble Way, Colchester, CO2 8RT
VAT Reg: GB 412 8876 21

INVOICE  NG-2026-0417
Date: 14/07/2026
Due: 30 days

Qty  Description                  Unit     Amount
12   A4 copier paper (box)        4.75     57.00
3    Toner cartridge TN-247BK    68.40    205.20
1    Delivery                     6.50      6.50

Subtotal        268.70
VAT @ 20%        53.74
TOTAL DUE       322.44 GBP`
  },
  {
    source: 'upload:receipt_scan_0912.jpg',
    invoiceText: `Cafe Rosetta
88 High Street, Chelmsford

09 Jul 2026   14:32

2x Flat white          6.40
1x Toasted sandwich    5.95

Total            12.35
Incl VAT          2.06
CARD ****4417`
  },
  {
    source: 'email:billing@meridian-cloud.io',
    invoiceText: `Meridian Cloud Services
Invoice MER-88213
Issued 1 July 2026

Platform subscription, July 2026 ......... 240.00
Overage (18 GB @ 0.40) ....................  7.20

Net 247.20
VAT 20% 49.44
Gross 296.64

Currency: EUR
Paid by direct debit`
  }
];

return samples.map(s => ({ json: s }));

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: The trading name of the business that issued the document. Not the customer.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Invoice or receipt number. If the document has no reference at all, return an empty string.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date the document was issued, exactly as written on the document. Do not reformat it.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code. Infer from the symbol or country if not stated explicitly.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total excluding VAT. If only a gross total and a VAT figure are shown, subtract to get this.

attributes.name: vat_amount
attributes.description: The VAT or tax amount. Return 0 if the document shows no VAT.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total actually payable, including VAT.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You extract accounting fields from supplier invoices and receipts.

Rules:
- Return only what is present on the document. Never invent a value to fill a field.
- Amounts are numbers with no currency symbols, no thousands separators.
- If a field is genuinely absent, return an empty string for text or 0 for numbers. Do not guess.
- The supplier is whoever issued the document, never the customer being billed.

parameters.content:
## 1. Input

Sample documents are inlined so the workflow runs with no credentials except the model.

At deployment this node is replaced by the client's real source — Gmail attachments, a Drive folder, or a webhook from their finance tool.

## 2. Extraction

The model reads unstructured text and returns typed fields.

Temperature is 0 and the prompt forbids inventing values — an absent field comes back empty rather than plausible-looking and wrong.

## 3. Validation — the part that matters

Arithmetic is never left to the model. This node re-checks that net + VAT equals gross, derives net where only gross was shown, sanity-checks the VAT rate against UK bands, and normalises dates to ISO.

Anything it cannot verify is flagged, not silently accepted.

## 4. Two outcomes

Clean rows go straight to export. Anything doubtful is flagged with the specific reason, so a human checks three documents rather than three hundred.

That split is the whole value: the automation is trusted because it says when not to trust it.
